entry.text: Ran the gate; biome flagged two unused imports in compose.ts and I removed them.
From now on the soak harness runs nightly, never on every push.
Confirmed again that bare bun test is not the gate; bun run test is.
Looked through the theme gallery screenshots with Jordan.
Event names are dotted and lowercase, like memory.decided.
The release workflow now also publishes the npm package after tagging.
